known_secrets.text: Three years ago I entered a forbidden terrace near the upper monument.
I found a carved symbol hidden beneath moss.
The symbol matches one found in the small ancient building.
I made a sketch and hid it in my room.
I suspect the monument and small building were built by the same people.
I have considered entering sealed areas alone.
I have not yet found a way inside.

unknowns: What caused the Night of Ash
